info.title: signalk-imo-alerts
info.description: Spoken alert announcements and IMO A.1021(26) alert tone patterns

get.summary: List currently active (voiceable) alerts, including any /test-announce entries (tracked at synthetic paths test.announce.<priority>) alongside real alerts.*-backed ones

revision.description: Monotonic, changes on every fresh occurrence (including a deliberate /test-announce resubmission with identical priority/message) - a more robust 'is this actually new' signal for a client than path+message alone

toneCode.description: Only present for a /test-announce entry with an explicit tone override

tonePattern.description: Only present for a /test-announce entry with an explicit custom pattern

language.description: Only present for a /test-announce entry with an explicit language override

voice.description: Only present for a /test-announce entry with an explicit voice override

get.summary: List available priorities and built-in tone codes, for the test-mode form

configuredDefault.description: The currently configured default tone for this priority (cautionTone/warningTone/alarmTone/emergencyAlarmTone in plugin config)

pattern.description: Custom pattern, set when preset is 'custom'

description.description: Short human-readable description, e.g. 'Square pulse train'

musterListCodes.description: Configured 1.b ship-specific muster-list codes (plugin config), offered as additional selectable tone options

voice.description: Configured voice/language settings, so the webapp can default its test-mode voice field to what's actually configured. Used for both local-speaker and browser playback (one TTS engine serves both).

get.summary: Serve a tone clip's audio, either a built-in code, a custom pattern, or a priority's default

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Priority to use its default tone

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Notification path, used alongside priority to check for a matching musterListCodes override before falling back to the priority's default - without this, a muster-list path's configured tone would be invisible to a priority-only lookup

400.description: No code/pattern/priority given, or invalid pattern

post.summary: Trigger a test announcement, combining any priority/tone/message/language/voice (for verifying pronunciation, volume, tone selection, and voice model before trusting it live). Pushes into the same alert queue real alerts.* alerts use, at a synthetic path (test.announce.<priority>) - so it follows the real priority-preemption/repeat/silence rules, shows up in GET /active, and plays in every open webapp tab via that endpoint's existing polling, not just wherever this call was made.

toneCode.description: Built-in code, or 'none'; omit to use the priority's default

tonePattern.description: Custom pattern, overrides toneCode if given

voice.description: espeak-ng voice/variant override, e.g. 'en-us'; overrides the configured serverVoice/language for this announcement only

path.description: The synthetic queue path this test was pushed to (test.announce.<priority>) - pass this to /acknowledge or /silence to stop it

spokenMessage.description: The message after pronunciation substitution - matches what GET /active will report for this entry

get.summary: Synthesize and serve a message's raw audio on demand (not cached - message text is usually dynamic). Used by the webapp to play the exact same audio the local speaker would.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Text to synthesize - pronunciation substitution is NOT applied here; pass already-substituted text (see /test-announce's spokenMessage, or /active's message for real alerts)

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Overrides the configured language for this request only

parameters.name: voice
parameters.description: Overrides the configured serverVoice for this request only

post.summary: Acknowledge an active alert. For a real alerts.*-backed alert, proxies to signalk-alert-manager's own REST API (POST /plugins/signalk-alert-manager/alerts/{id}/acknowledge) using the configured alertManagerToken - alert manager is the single source of truth, and this plugin's own state updates from the resulting alerts.* delta, not from this call directly. For a /test-announce entry (path test.announce.<priority>), acknowledges directly on the local queue instead, since there's no real alert-manager id to proxy to.

400.description: Invalid request body, or no alertManagerToken configured

404.description: No known alert for that path (nothing has been seen on alerts.* for it)

post.summary: Temporarily silence an active alert. For a real alerts.*-backed alert, proxies to signalk-alert-manager's own REST API (POST /plugins/signalk-alert-manager/alerts/{id}/silence) - it does not auto-resume on any local timer, only when a fresh alerts.* delta reports silenced: false. For a /test-announce entry (path test.announce.<priority>), silences directly on the local queue instead, with the same no-local-timer behavior.

durationSeconds.description: Silence duration in seconds. If omitted, alert manager applies its own configured default for the alert's priority.

400.description: Invalid request body, or no alertManagerToken configured

404.description: No known alert for that path (nothing has been seen on alerts.* for it)
